breakdown.description: Saturation temperature is inconsistent with the stated condenser pressure (10 kPa does not correspond to 100 C).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the physical inconsistency between the stated pressure (10 kPa) and saturation temperature (100 C). It resolved this by prioritizing the given pressure and explicitly stating to use the correct corresponding saturation temperature (~45.8 °C) instead of the incorrect 100 °C provided by the user. This matches the correction made in the ground truth.
